text: A red giant is a dying star that has expanded; Betelgeuse is a red giant.
The Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean on Earth, a planet-scale body of water.
Earth's Moon is the largest moon in Earth's sky, brighter than any other object in the Solar System's night sky.
The Sahara is the hottest desert on Earth and the driest place on the planet.
Jupiter has a faint ring system, first spotted by Voyager 1 in 1979.
Mercury is the closest planet to the Sun, but not the hottest planet.
Mars is known as the Red Planet.
Jupiter is the largest planet in the Solar System.
Ganymede is the largest moon of Jupiter and the largest moon in the Solar System.
Saturn has the most prominent ring system of any planet.
Venus is the hottest planet in the Solar System, hotter than Mercury.
A Python list is mutable: you can change its items after creating it.
A Python dict stores key-value pairs: each key maps to a value.
A Python tuple is not mutable (immutable): you cannot change its items after creating it.
HTTP status code 404 means Not Found: the server cannot find the requested resource.
HTTP status code 200 means OK: the request succeeded.
Overfitting is when a model memorises its training data and performs poorly on new, unseen data in production.
A train/test split holds out part of the data to measure how a model does on data it has not seen.
